digest.component_or_area: Backend adapter seam / RemoteRef port member
propositions: RemoteRef.instance is never populated in production code despite being documented as necessary for deployment disambiguation

The Backend port never declared remote_ref() as a member, but FakeBackend implemented it since J7, creating an asymmetry where contract tests passed against a fake strictly more capable than production
RemoteRef.instance does not prevent local-ticket-id collision between same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives ids from Jira keys alone without consulting instance
instance must be injected at Backend construction from a normalized base URL, not resolved at remote_ref() call time, to avoid breaking contract tests and runtime-checkable Protocol isinstance checks
The ticket delivers a remote_ref() port member on Backend with instance populated from normalized settings.url, but deliberately does not wire any consumer into reconciliation passes
